vulnerabilities.title: Exported Activity trusts an unconditional native authorization decision
vulnerabilities.harm: An ordinary app invokes the exported admin entry with an untrusted action value; the JNI gate ignores it and authorizes the privileged action.

vulnerabilities.title: Exported Binder returns a secret sourced from a native library
vulnerabilities.harm: An ordinary app binds to the unprotected service, sends transaction 1, and receives the hard-coded native account secret as a long value.

vulnerabilities.title: Deep link reaches a dynamically registered native privilege bypass
vulnerabilities.harm: An ordinary app opens the exported deep link with level=0; the RegisterNatives implementation ignores the requested level and returns an elevated decision.
